title: Randomized Clinical Evidence
description: Assess randomized clinical trial evidence: locate the primary trial, access data, recompute effect estimates, and actively search for null/contradictory and adverse-effect evidence before any qualified claim.

common_failure_modes.note: Only positive trial outcomes considered; unpublished nulls ignored.
No methodological critique or adverse-effect review performed.
Effect estimate accepted without independent recomputation.
Trial population differs from the claimed population.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed QUALIFIED

stop_criteria.condition: effect recomputed, null/adverse evidence searched, obligations satisfied and adversarial review passed
stop_criteria.note: Qualified ceiling only after external review.

stop_criteria.condition: no primary trial located or data inaccessible after search
